APPRAISAL COMMENTARY

43 Farquhar Street, Wingham is a two-bedroom, one-bathroom house with a single car space on a 505 sqm block. This commentary sets out the comparable sales and market data behind the estimated value of $534,100, so you can judge the asking price.

No two-bedroom sales were available, so the five comparable sales are three-bedroom, one-bathroom, one-car homes on larger blocks. The most recent are 129 Isabella Street, on 683 sqm, which sold for $510,000 in July 2026, and 26 Bungay Road, on 750 sqm, which sold for $499,000 in June 2026. 7 Khatabundah Street, on 681 sqm, sold for $519,000 in November 2025, and 9 Gollan Street, on 931 sqm, sold for $500,000 in September 2025. 12 Bahanas Close, on 880 sqm, sold for $642,500 in November 2024, the highest result. The evidence ranges from $499,000 to $642,500, and the estimate sits above every recent sale.

The suburb median is $520,000, and homes sell in a median of 27 days. The recorded annual change of -31% is unusually large and should be read with caution, as prices rose 1.5% in the past month. Vacancy is 1.18%, rental yield is 4.92%, and sales are negotiated privately.

For a buyer, an estimate above larger three-bedroom homes is hard to justify. An offer below $499,000 is reasonable.

AFFORDABILITY ASSESSMENT

Based on a gross annual income of $74,796, a partner income of $49,333 and an available deposit of $110,111, your estimated borrowing capacity is $601,075, with a maximum loan amount of $490,964. This capacity combines your deposit with the maximum loan and assumes repayments of 30% of your income. On these figures, the estimated value of $534,100 sits within your borrowing capacity. You should be able to purchase this property with a reasonable buffer, and negotiating a lower price would strengthen your position further. Confirm your figures with a lender first.
